title: Mathé
description: A tea brochure website built with React, Gatsby and DatoCMS.
moreInfo: Personally designed and developed for a local tea company.  Website serves as an online brochure for Mathé's products.  An online store is soon to be added with the Shopify API.

title: Street Eats
description: Designed and developed a mock e-commerce food delivery app.  Built from scratch with React, Next.js, Material-UI, Strapi (headless CMS) and PostgreSQL.
features: User creation enabled and authentication managed with JWT
Listings, products, user permissions, etc. created and managed with Strapi
Assets (images, etc.) served and manipulated with Cloudinary

title: Portfolio

moreInfo: The original version of this portfolio, built with Gatsby and React. Integrated with DatoCMS and deployed on Netlify.

title: WatchStuff
description: A Youtube clone built with React, Redux and the Youtube API.
moreInfo: Built for learning purposes and personal use.  Project served as introduction to Youtube API and Redux Saga.  Redux Saga used to help manage complex Redux state.

title: Git the Issue
description: App that tracks issues on Github.  Built with Apollo and React and interacts with the Github API.
moreInfo: Built for learning purposes with Apollo and React.  This project served as my introduction to GraphQL and Apollo.

title: DevConnector
description: Full stack social networking app.  Built using React, Redux, Express, MongoDb and deployed on Heroku.
moreInfo:
Features user account sign-up and login pages.  Authenticated users can create, edit and delete profiles.  Authenticated users can view a posts feed where they communicate with other developers, allowing them to add, delete, like and unlike comments.  In addition to user entered data, user profiles also pull data in from Github and Gravatar, if available.  User's 5 most recent Github repositories and Gravatar avatar images will be displayed.

Built for learning purposes, primarily as an introduction to back-end development.  Learned the basics of Node, MongoDb and authentication using JSON web tokens.
features: Create, edit and delete user profiles

title: Awesome Employee Directory
description: Mock company employee directory. AJAX used to pull data from a random employee API, which populates screen with tiles of employee info.
moreInfo:
Features a search/filter of returned employees.  Each employee tile is clickable into modal overlay that displays more information.  Employees can be traversed from the modal, without closing the modal.

Assigned from Treehouse Tech Degree Program (www.teamtreehouse.com).

title: Interactive Photo Gallery
description: Interactive photo gallery that displays images larger when clicked.
moreInfo:
My intro to CSS grid system and modal overlays.  

Features a photo grid layout and a search/filter functionality of returned photos.  Each photo can be clicked and enlarged onto a modal (overlay).  Photos can be traversed back/forward on the modal.

Assigned from Treehouse Tech Degree Program (www.teamtreehouse.com).
